items.description: A vulnerability exists in a monitoring component that may, under certain conditions, allow security controls to be circumvented. Successful exploitation could result in unauthorized access to information intended for authorized users only.

A vulnerability exists in a network-facing component that may, under certain conditions, result in service disruption. Successful exploitation could cause temporary unavailability of affected functionality.

A vulnerability exists in a system component that may, under certain conditions, disrupt the availability of affected services. Successful exploitation could result in temporary service interruption or loss of functionality.

A vulnerability exists in a system component that may, under certain conditions, allow an authorized user to make unauthorized changes to system-managed content. Successful exploitation could affect system confidentiality, integrity, and availability, and may disrupt trusted interactions among syste

A vulnerability exists in a system interface that may, under certain conditions, fail to properly enforce authorization boundaries. Successful exploitation could allow an unauthorized party to access or modify protected system information, potentially affecting confidentiality and integrity.
